data.name: Ananias
data.gender_notes: Ananias is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Ananiyas (ענניהו 'Ananiyahu') is derived from 'anan' meaning 'grace' or 'God is gracious'. In Greek, it is Ananias, derived from 'ananas' meaning 'grace' or 'favor'. The name Ananias carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ananias usually hope their child will grow to embody god is gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ananias belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ananias total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: עֲנָנְיָה
in_hebrew.meaning: ה' עזרני, ה' חנני, חסד אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עֲנָנְיָה הוא שם פרטי עברי שפירושו 'ה' עזרני' או 'ה' חנני'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'עֲנָן' שפירושו 'ענן' או 'חסד', ו'יָה' שפירושו 'אלוהים' או 'ה''. השם מופיע בתנ'ך, בספר מעשי השליחים, כשהוא שם של תלמיד ישו.

in_greek.name: Ἀνανίας
in_greek.meaning: ὁ Θεός μου ἔδωκεν, ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἀνανίας (Ananias) σημαίνει 'ὁ Θεός μου ἔδωκεν' ἤ 'ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ'. Εἶναι ὄνομα ἑβραϊκό, τὸ ὁποῖο ἀναφέρεται στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, συγκεκριμένα στὸ βιβλίο τῶν Πράξεων τῶν Αποστόλων, ὡς ὄνομα μαθητοῦ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

in_latin.name: Ananias
in_latin.long_meaning: Ananias nomen hebraicum est quod significat 'Deus meus donavit' vel 'gratia Dei'. In Ecclesia primitiva, hoc nomen gestavit discipulus Iesu, cuius historia refertur in Actibus Apostolorum.

in_english.name: Ananias
in_english.meaning: God has helped, gracious, favored by God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ananias originates from Hebrew, meaning 'God has helped' or 'gracious'. It appears in the New Testament, specifically in the Acts of the Apostles, as the name of a disciple of Jesus. Historically, Ananias has been associated with spiritual significance, symbolizing divine assistance and favor. The name has been adopted across various Christian cultures, reflecting its biblical roots and enduring legacy.

data.cultural_impact: Ananias is a name of various historical and biblical figures, most notably from the New Testament. He was a disciple in Damascus who played a pivotal role in the conversion of Saul, who later became Paul when he spread the message of Christianity to the Gentiles. This name is rich in Christian tradition and history, representing acts of bravery and faith that led to the growth and spread of Christianity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ananias holds a deep spiritual significance, a reminder that God's grace extends beyond cultural or geographical boundaries. It highlights the importance of courage and faith in sharing the message of Christianity, inspiring us to be like Ananias and reflect His grace in every aspect of our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ananias means "God has favored [him] with grace." In the Bible, Ananias is a disciple who heeds God's call to heal Paul after his Damascus Road conversion. This name embodies God's grace and favor towards those who follow His will.

biblical_reference.note: Ananias was a disciple of Jesus and a companion of Saint Paul.

historical_references.context: A disciple of the apostle Paul who helped him after his conversion to Christianity.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ananias remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Ananias in Rome, Italy credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Ananias, which means "God is gracious". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
